about: Measured translation quality per layer and language pair (plan 6.4): chrF (sacreBLEU chrF2, 0–100) on the mt-he-en golden set's dev split, both directions, from `node scripts/golden/evals/mt.mjs --dev`. `null` = not measured yet. The baseline is Opus-MT (layer 2): a layer whose measured chrF for a pair is below the baseline's is never chosen automatically for that pair; an unmeasured layer is chosen only when no measured one is available, and the result says so.
